test.summary: Global - Application dumps migrating - JCMA BigPicture
test.description:
Before sanity tests create environment:

*JCMA - PRODUCTION TO PREPROD*

Create a Jira DC instance with 2 nodes, without the apps and with a database appropriate to the most recently released DC versions ([+#bp-status-release-feature+|https://appfireworkspace.slack.com/archives/C034T18L5RQ] version cut off/preprod date, e.g. preprod/2025-11-17/8.64 - database date min. 1 day before cut off), GIT_COMMIT_ID can be develop from branch for appropriate Jira version, FORGE_ENVIRONMENT_NAME: production. [+https://ci.softwareplant.com/job/QA/job/PERSONAL/job/_JIRA_DC/job/JIRA_DC_START/+|https://ci.softwareplant.com/job/QA/job/PERSONAL/job/_JIRA_DC/job/JIRA_DC_START/]
Upload the BP app from the marketplace.
Navigate to Jira Administration - Manage apps and update Jira Cloud Migration Assistant app. 

Create a new Jira Cloud instance in [Sign up - Jira - Try Atlassian Cloud | Atlassian|https://www.atlassian.com/try/cloud/signup?product=confluence.ondemand,jira-software.ondemand,jira-servicedesk.ondemand,jira-core.ondemand&developer=true]  and create some space (e.g. Software development - Scrum - Company-managed space).
Upload BP from the marketplace.
Move the app to the preprod version in: [+https://admin-cloud.softwareplant.com/+|https://admin-cloud.softwareplant.com/]. Wait about 1 hour until the app updates its version, or ask the manager for a force move.

*JCMA - PREPROD TO PREPROD*

Create a Jira DC instance with 2 nodes, with the apps (GIT_COMMIT_ID preprod from branch for appropriate Jira version), and with a database appropriate to the most recently released DC versions ([+#bp-status-release-feature+|https://appfireworkspace.slack.com/archives/C034T18L5RQ] version cut off/preprod date, e.g. preprod/2025-11-17/8.64 - database date min. 1 day before cut off), FORGE_ENVIRONMENT_NAME: production. [+https://ci.softwareplant.com/job/QA/job/PERSONAL/job/_JIRA_DC/job/JIRA_DC_START/+|https://ci.softwareplant.com/job/QA/job/PERSONAL/job/_JIRA_DC/job/JIRA_DC_START/]
Navigate to Jira Administration - Manage apps and update Jira Cloud Migration Assistant app.

Create a new Jira Cloud instance in [+Sign up - Jira - Try Atlassian Cloud | Atlassian+|https://www.atlassian.com/try/cloud/signup?product=confluence.ondemand,jira-software.ondemand,jira-servicedesk.ondemand,jira-core.ondemand&developer=true]  and create some space (e.g. Software development - Scrum - Company-managed space).
Upload BP from the marketplace.
Move the app to the preprod version in: [+https://admin-cloud.softwareplant.com/+|https://admin-cloud.softwareplant.com/]. Wait about 1 hour until the app updates its version, or ask the manager for a force move.

*JCMA - DEVELOP TO DEVELOP*

Create a Jira DC instance with 2 nodes, with the apps (GIT_COMMIT_ID develop from branch for appropriate Jira version), and the latest database, FORGE_ENVIRONMENT_NAME: your CONTEXT_PATH used to build your Jira cloud instance. [+https://ci.softwareplant.com/job/QA/job/PERSONAL/job/_JIRA_DC/job/JIRA_DC_START/+|https://ci.softwareplant.com/job/QA/job/PERSONAL/job/_JIRA_DC/job/JIRA_DC_START/]
Navigate to Jira Administration - Manage apps and update Jira Cloud Migration Assistant app.

Create a new Jira Cloud instance in [+Sign up - Jira - Try Atlassian Cloud | Atlassian+|https://www.atlassian.com/try/cloud/signup?product=confluence.ondemand,jira-software.ondemand,jira-servicedesk.ondemand,jira-core.ondemand&developer=true]+,+ in JIRA_INSTANCE_URL add DC instance name (e.g. [jkowalski.atlassian.net|http://jkowalski.atlassian.net]), and create some space (e.g. Software development - Scrum - Company-managed space).

steps.action: Cloud instance: Navigate to App Configuration -> Techical info
steps.result:
Technical info tab is displayed
'Allow JCMA migration' switcher is gray and disabled

steps.action: Click on switcher 'Allow JCMA migration'
steps.result: Switcher 'Allow JCMA migration' is green and enabled

steps.action:
Jira DC Instance: 

Navigate Jira Administration -> User Management 
Create a new user with your email address
steps.result: User is created

steps.action:
Navigate to the Box configuration → Tasks → Scope definition of the boxName
Expand Advanced configuration, and add the new created user as a Scope Owner
steps.data: boxName:  TC-4255 Global - Application dumps migrating - JCMA BigPicture
steps.result: User is added

steps.action: Jira DC Instance: Navigate to BigPicture App Configuration -> Advanced -> Database dumps
steps.result: Database dumps tab is displayed

steps.action: Click on 'New Dump' and select JCMA Dump
steps.result:
New JCMA snapshot' is displayed

* Required field 'Migration name' with 'i' icon and tooltip 'Enter a unique migration name you will later need to identify this snapshot in JCMA' is displayed
* Required field 'Description' is displayed

Following text is displayed: 'Creating a database dump will restart the App and may take a significant amount of time and resources, so we recommend running it during non-business hours. Do not interrupt the process or disable the App until the dump is complete.' 

Create snapshot (grayed out)  and Cancel button are displayed

steps.action: Type migrationName and description, then click on Create snapshot
steps.result:
Dialog appears:
"Reinstall the App manually
Due to your Jira multi-node instance configuration, restoring the selected backup will take effect after you reinstall the BigPicture App manually."
with the Manage Apps button

steps.action:
Click on the Manage Apps button.
Disable (with don't send feedback) and enable the BigPicture app.
Go back to the previous tab and refresh the page.
steps.result: Creating snapshot has started

steps.action: Navigate to Jira Administration -> System -> Migrate to Cloud
steps.result: Migration Dashboard is displayed with ‘Create new migration’ button

steps.action: Click on ‘Create new migration' button
steps.result:
Message window appears with statement:
"You haven't reviewed your email domains
You can only migrate users from domains you trust. You’ll need to review the email domains and mark those domains as trusted.
You can continue without reviewing the domains, but to protect the security of your cloud site, you won’t be able to migrate until all domains are trusted."
Two buttons are under the statement: 'Continue without reviewing' and ‘Review domains’

steps.action: Click on ‘Review domains' button
steps.result:
'Connect to cloud' page is displayed
Choose your destination cloud site* required field is visible with 'Choose cloud site' button and Jira Cloud trial link

steps.action: Select 'Choose cloud site' button and then Continue
steps.result:
Choose your destination cloud site' page is displayed

There are following required fields:

* Migrate from
* Migrate to
* Chceckbox 'Allow Atlassian to access migrations data to perform your migration'

steps.action: Type migrateFrom and migrateTo, click on checkbox and Confirm
steps.data:
migrateFrom: DC InstanceURL (f.e [https://qa.softwareplant.com/dc/name|https://qa.softwareplant.com/dc/name])

migrateTo: Cloud InstanceURL (f.e [https://bigpictureone-name.atlassian.net|https://bigpictureone-name.atlassian.net])
steps.result:
‘Connect to cloud' page is displayed
Choose your destination cloud site* required field is visible with ‘Choose cloud site' button and Jira Cloud trial link
Two buttons are visible at the bottom: 'Back’ and 'Review all domains’

steps.action:
Click on ‘Review all domains’ button and then ‘Begin assessing’ button
Wait for a while
Select every possible domain as ‘Trusted domain' and click on 'Done’ button
steps.result:
Migration Assistant home is displayed. 

Following tiles are displayed:

* Assess your instance with 'Begin assessing' button
* Access your apps with 'View App assessment' button
* Prepare apps with 'Begin preparing' button
* Assess and prepare your users with 'Begin assessing' button
* Review all email domains with ‘Review’ button
* Migrate your users in advance (recommended) with ‘Migrate users’ button
* Migrate your data with 'Create migration' and 'Manage your migrations' buttons

steps.action: Click on ‘Begin assessing’ in Assess your instance and confirm by ‘Begin assessing’ button
steps.result:
Assess your instance
Assess the scale, performance, and usage of your instance. We'll use the results to help you create a migration strategy. You can continue your work while the assessment is running.
COMPLETED
You can download the report for another 13 days.
Finished (with the elapsed time given)
Two buttons are visible: ‘Download report’ and ‘Assess again’

Information below:
Atlassian Administration
If you have a cloud organization, you can view your cloud readiness report in Portfolio insights, with additional recommendations on improving your data.
'How to get started' button

steps.action: Click on ‘View App assessment’ button in 'Assess your apps’ section
steps.result:
Following table with columns is displayed:

* User installed apps (1): BigPicture
* Cloud visibility: Yes
* Migration path: Automated path
* App usage: arrow redirecting to App usage
* Decision: Needed in Cloud

'Done' button is displayed at the bottom

steps.action: Click 'Done'
steps.result:
Page with App assessment is closed

Message:"App assessment is complete
Prepare your apps to continue" is displayed

steps.action: Click ‘Continue preparing’ button in ‘Prepare your apps’ section and then 'Continue’ button
steps.result:
Agree to app migration' page is displayed with folLowing data:

* Apps needed in cloud (1) 
* App migration agreement status - 
"The policy you agreed to has been updated. Review changes and agree again before your app data can be migrated."
* Policy details - View policy

steps.action: Click on ‘View policy’ and Confirm
steps.result:
Agree to app migration' page is displayed with folLowing data:

* Apps needed in cloud (1) 
* App migration agreement status - 
You have agreed to third-party automated app data migration for this app.
* Policy details - Revoke agreement

steps.action: Click on Done
steps.result:
Page with Preparing app is closed

Message "Apps are ready to migrate
Select Create a migration." is displayed

steps.action:
Click on ‘Begin assessing’ button in ‘Asses and prepare your users’ section.
Click ‘Begin assessing’ on Connect to Cloud page and then click on ‘Begin assessing’ button on Review page.
steps.result:
Results page is displayed

Check that all your users have valid and unique email addresses as required in cloud. Choose what to do with any invalid accounts.

In the next steps, we'll ask you to decide what to do with any invalid and duplicate email addresses we found in the most recent user assessment.
Your choices will apply to all future migrations.

Invalid email addresses 2
Assessment completed on Today’s date

All email addresses are unique

3 buttons are visible at the bottom: ‘Back’, ‘Asses again’, ‘Fix or customize users’

steps.action:
Click on ‘Fix or customize users’ button, then ‘Next’ button.
Select ‘Migrate invalid users as Former users’ button, click on ‘Review and apply’ button, and ‘Apply to all migrations’ button.
steps.result:
Page is closed.

Message: ‘Your users are ready to migrate to cloud
Select Create a migration to create a new migration plan.’ is displayed.

steps.action: Click on Create a migration -> Connect to cloud
steps.result:
Connect to your cloud site page is displayed

Two required fields are displayed:

* Name your migration
* Choose your destination cloud site

steps.action:
Type name, choose migrationStage and select cloudSite
Then click ‘Choose migration options’ button
steps.data:
name: JCMABP
migrationStage: Production migration stage
cloudSite: Cloud instance URL (f.e  [https://bigpictureone-name.atlassian.net|https://bigpictureone-name.atlassian.net])
steps.result:
Choose your migration options page is displayed with folLowing options: 

* Projects
* Advanced Roadmaps plans
* Dashboards, boards and filters
* Users and Groups
* Apps

steps.action:
Choose project, Skip plans, Skip in Dashboards, boards and filters, select usersAndGroups and apps 
Click ‘Save and run pre-migration checks’ button
steps.data:
project: TC-4255 JCMA BigPicture
usersAndGroups: All users and groups from the Jira directory
apps: All - 1 marked as Needed in cloud with a migration path
steps.result:
Pre migration check complited
‘Back’, ‘Stop’, ‘Refresh all’, ‘Review migration’ buttons are displayed at the bottom

steps.action:
Click on ‘Review migration’, click ‘Continue’ button and then click on ‘Run’
On Migration dashboard click on ‘View details’ in migration row
steps.result: Migration starts and ends with 100% success

steps.action: AFTER migration: Navigate to Cloud instance and go to App Configuration -> Advanced -> Technical info
steps.result:
Allow JCMA migration switcher is gray and disabled

Message appeared in right-corner: 
'Migration completed successfully
The migration went error-free on the BigPicture side. We still encourage you to verify all the elements on your end.This message will disappear after the next BigPicture update.'

steps.action:
Navigate to Jira settings -> User management
Click on ‘review now’ link on the yellow banner at the top of the page
Click on ‘Review’, ‘Approve', and 'Done’
steps.result: Imported groups have been approved and roles assigned

steps.action: Clear cache, wait 10 minutes, and navigate to Resources module of a boxName
steps.data: boxName:  TC-4255 Global - Application dumps migrating - JCMA BigPicture
steps.result:
The individual view is set by default.

Timeline starts from 01/Aug/2023

Following tasks are displayed in  Resource Grid:

* TC4255-1 Task 1 is assigned to user TC-4255
* TC4255-2 Task 2 and TC 4255-3 Task 3 are unassigned

Time period is set to Month/Weekly.

Following values are displayed for Week 32 for user TC-4255;
Workload - 32.0 in green
Remaining Capacity - 8.0 in green
Capacity - 40.0 in grey
